name: splatmaker-mcp
description: Self-hosted, zero-marginal-cost Gaussian-splat generation. FOSS alternative to paid splat APIs - point at a video or images, get a navigable 3D world, computed on local hardware (Nerfstudio/Splatfacto).

tools.name: splat_generate
tools.description: Generate or inspect a Gaussian-splat world: from_video, from_images, status, list, get_asset

tools.name: splat_engine_status
tools.description: Report engine install state plus cached ns-train --help verification (verified ok/broken/missing/pending)

tools.name: server_shutdown
tools.description: Gracefully shut down this server (explicit user request only)

tools.name: show_status_card
tools.description: Engine + job-queue status as a rich Prefab card
